kind.description: The kind of file content (Type, topic, guide, etc.)

source.description: The original source content of the file. Will be exported with its original file extension.

html.description:
The rendered HTML content of the file.

For notebooks, this contains the rendered HTML using [nbconvert](https://nbconvert.readthedocs.io/en/latest/).

file.description: The original file that documentation was generated for.

dirName.description:
If provided, the name of the directory to write all content to. If not provided,
the name of the #file without the extension will be used.
